verdict.rationale: Canva documents both a Connect API and an official MCP server whose tools explicitly include 'Design export: Generate exports in multiple formats (PDF, PNG, JPG, PPTX, MP4, and so on)' alongside programmatic design generation/editing, and a runtime probe confirms the hosted MCP server at mcp.canva.com is live and speaks MCP/OAuth as documented. This gives an AI agent a documented programmatic surface for rendering and exporting designs. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of an actual successful export call (probe only reached the auth challenge) and clearer parity between MCP tools and raw Connect API export endpoints.
